_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi_xfem#5 and a FALSIFICATION. The entry told the reader to open the IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT fluid VTU in ParaView and look at hexes crossing the structure. On the upstream monolithic deck xfsi_3D_boxes there is no such file to open: adding IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT plus the FLUID and STRUCTURE sub-sections aborts before the first step with 'Runtime output is not available in the old structure time integration! You need to take the new one, i.e. set INT_STRATEGY: Standard!' from 4C_structure_timint.cpp, and following that instruction changes nothing -- the XFSI adapter constructs the legacy integrator regardless, so the identical throw reappears and zero .vtu files are produced in both arms. Combined with fourc::xfem_fluid#6 (an XFEM fluid writes no VTU even when the run succeeds), XFEM results have to be inspected through the Ensight .result file or the Gmsh .pos output. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
expect_in_output: Runtime output is not available in the old structure time integration!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: do not add the runtime VTK sections, so nothing asks the legacy structure integrator for runtime output. The throw and both zero-VTU counts stop being evidence and EXIT_VTK becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
